scope: User-confirmed representative Venice selection: 14 distinct asset prototypes plus one separate background. Art remains subject to generation and visual acceptance.

items.name: 粉色民居
items.identity_brief: A narrow salmon-pink Venetian house with a terra-cotta gable roof, arched green door, a few arched windows and simple attached flowerboxes.
items.selection_reason: 代表普通临河民居；保留一款，不把其他墙色另算。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 带棚店铺
items.identity_brief: The yellow Venetian shop beside the central pink house, with a red pitched roof, green shutters and a blue ground-floor shop canopy. Exclude the neighboring pink house and foreground trees.
items.selection_reason: 通过底层营业雨棚与店面结构区分普通民居，不按墙面颜色凑一种。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 拱廊楼
items.identity_brief: The tall pale pink Venetian building with a row of open stone arcades at ground level along the upper-right image edge. Keep the arcade building only, exclude the foreground bell tower and adjacent houses, and complete the part cropped by the frame.
items.selection_reason: 以地面层柱廊和连续拱门提供不同建筑轮廓；原图有边缘裁切，后续只补全必要隐蔽部分。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 钟楼
items.identity_brief: A slender salmon-colored Venetian bell tower with a teal pyramidal spire, cream belfry framing, a bronze bell and a simple stone base.
items.selection_reason: 地标建筑，竖向轮廓与普通房屋明显区分。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 空贡多拉
items.identity_brief: One empty Venetian gondola with a curved blue hull, restrained gold-colored rim, red seat and wood interior. Remove its living rider and handheld oar.
items.selection_reason: 威尼斯主题核心交通工具。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 空水上巴士
items.identity_brief: One empty Venetian waterbus with a rounded cream canopy, open-sided cabin, simple seats, cream sides and a blue hull with a red stripe. Remove passengers.
items.selection_reason: 有顶棚的公共水上交通，与小船区别明确。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 小帆船
items.identity_brief: The small warm-brown sailboat in the lower-right canal, with a tall cream triangular sail and a curved blue lower hull. Separate its goose occupant and remove water or wakes.
items.selection_reason: 帆、桅杆和船身轮廓与贡多拉及水上巴士明显不同。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 鹅雕像喷泉
items.identity_brief: A circular cream stone fountain with contained turquoise water and a central goose sculpture on a pedestal; the sculpture belongs to the fountain. Exclude surrounding planters.
items.selection_reason: 广场核心设施，雕像与水盆保持为一个完整功能资产。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 单头路灯
items.identity_brief: One upright slender teal-blue Venetian street lamp with a single warm yellow lantern and a complete simple base.
items.selection_reason: 公共照明设施，只选一款代表性路灯。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 长椅
items.identity_brief: One wooden park bench with a slatted warm-brown seat and backrest and curved teal metal legs, from the upper-right plaza. Exclude nearby birds and paving.
items.selection_reason: 补充可复用的休憩设施，采用一款完整长椅，不按重复实例计数。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 系船柱
items.identity_brief: One freestanding red-and-cream striped Venetian mooring pole with a small ochre cap at the central-left quay. Include the complete pole and exclude the quay, water and nearby house.
items.selection_reason: 水城主题识别度高的小型设施；从背景独立拆出，便于按需放置。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 船夫鹅
items.identity_brief: One goose gondolier with a straw boater hat and red band, navy-and-white striped shirt, red neckerchief, orange beak and webbed feet. Complete the body hidden by its boat.
items.selection_reason: 船夫职业身份明确，与空贡多拉分别计为两个独立资产。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 面具鹅
items.identity_brief: One cream-white goose in a red-and-gold Venetian carnival mask and costume, orange beak and webbed feet. Keep its mask identity while simplifying the outfit.
items.selection_reason: 面具和服装具有鲜明主题辨识度。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 画家鹅
items.identity_brief: The goose painter near the easel in the right-center plaza, wearing a blue beret and holding a small paintbrush or palette. Keep the character and handheld tools only; exclude the separate easel, lamp and ground.
items.selection_reason: 与船夫和面具鹅具有不同职业服饰及手持工具，角色差异明确。

source_evidence.basis: manual observation of the sole Venice Stage 1 image; approximate source crop

items.name: 空背景
items.identity_brief: The Venice canal network, pale stone paved quays, stone embankments and four fixed arch bridges. Remove all independent buildings, boats, characters, movable facilities and vegetation.
